capabilities.justification: Resolves the current user's standard configuration, local-data, and cache directories without hard-coding a home path.

capabilities.target: resolved vault-pm configuration file, data, cache, and lock paths
capabilities.justification: Inspects every local root, lock object, and bounded configuration file without following links before returning paths or exact bytes.

capabilities.target: resolved vault-pm configuration file, data, cache, and lock paths
capabilities.justification: Creates missing application roots, the persistent lock file, and same-directory configuration staging files with owner-only native security metadata.

capabilities.target: resolved vault-pm lock and configuration paths
capabilities.justification: Acquires an operating-system advisory lock and atomically publishes synchronized exact configuration bytes.

capabilities.target: libc descriptor-relative file APIs and Windows file/token/security APIs
capabilities.justification: Uses no-follow handles, native identity and access-control inspection, atomic publication, durable synchronization, and platform file locking unavailable through path-only filesystem calls.

capabilities.target: system temporary directory (VLT-PM48 agent runtime root)
capabilities.justification: Resolves and verifies the owner-private directory the local agent's Unix domain socket is bound at, deriving its path from a hash of the data root rather than any caller-supplied value.

capabilities.target: system temporary directory (VLT-PM48 agent runtime root)
capabilities.justification: Creates the owner-private (0700) runtime directory on first use by `agent start` or an opportunistic client lookup, verifying owner and mode with the same no-follow discipline as every other private root, but without walking that directory's platform-owned ancestry (see PreparedLocalVault::ensure_runtime_root).

justification: Local CLI trust-boundary adapter for platform-standard paths, owner-private directories and configuration, one-process-at-a-time vault access, and (VLT-PM48) the short owner-private runtime directory the local agent's socket is resolved beneath.
